Vitest is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2024 to 2026.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [algoglyph](@/work/algoglyph.md): Seeded, interactive p5.js plates: sorting, graphs, fractals, chaos, waves and gravity in 2D and 3D, each with measured readouts and a tested core; [dispatcher](@/work/dispatcher.md).

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Vitest: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Vitest to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
